item.title: Hacktoberfest 2026: A Festival for Threat Actors, a Nightmare for Security Teams
item.description: October 2026 has been a relentless month for cybersecurity, with threat actors exploiting critical vulnerabilities, compromising software supply chains, launching ransomware attacks, and exposing sensitive data. From zero-day exploits and credential theft to breaches affecting major organizations, the month’s events highlight how quickly the threat landscape continues to evolve. This roundup examines the most significant cyber incidents, security vulnerabilities, and emerging attack techniques reported throughout October, along with the lessons they offer defenders. For security teams, the challenge is no longer just responding to individual incidents, but staying ahead of an increasingly interconnected and fast-moving threat landscape.

item.title: Cyber Frontlines - How the Iran War Is Reshaping Global Cybersecurity
item.description: Recent escalations in the Iran war have turned cyberspace into a pivotal battlefield, with Israel’s massive cyberattack on February 28, 2026, marking a historic shift. This operation, dubbed part of Operation Roar of the Lion, combined airstrikes with digital strikes that crippled Iran’s infrastructure.
